title: The Drowned Choir Anew
author: Orsen Marchetti
blurb: Sebastian Marchetti, a beast-speaker hiding a forbidden gift, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. But when a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain before the usurper's armies reach the free cities.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
